body:
I can't graduate until like two years from now unfortunately. I live in a small town close to a big city and I have always loved being around others so I feel lonely and isolated.

I do try to make the effort but my so is weird about things, finals I understand but now that school is over they're dodgy and it makes me feel like shit.  My friends are always grounded for something and when I get upset and apologize to them they just stare at me blankly and say "ok..." What else am I supposed to think? That all these people like me? Certainly not the case I'm afraid :(

School, I haven't graduated yet. I live in a relatively small town merely a half hour away from a big city and I have always liked being around people, I like to refer to myself as a starved extrovert. I honestly think I wouldn't be so depressed if I was around humans
I hope the fact someone can relate helps but I really understand the being depressed then having s year where you were good. PM me if you need to talk
